use_case: Generative AI document extraction in the VCP: reads certificates of insurance, W-9s, and licenses, fills in fields (insured name, policy dates, coverage limits, TIN type), and drafts a compliance summary for the customer's reviewer
vendor_or_model: Generative AI model provider API (SYS-06), multimodal model; company-built prompts, field rules, and reviewer screen
data_categories: Full document images and text: vendor names, addresses, insurance policy details, license numbers, and taxpayer identification numbers including Social Security numbers (to be masked)
consequential_decision_category: Employment (vendors' eligibility for contracted work, treated as employment-like by analogy; legal scope not confirmed)
human_in_the_loop: Today: 31 of 45 customers use auto-accept, so extracted fields can change a vendor's status with no review. Condition: a customer reviewer must confirm expiry dates, coverage limits, and any status change; low-confidence fields are flagged
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01): deception (the 99% accuracy claim) and unfairness (unneeded Social Security numbers sent to a vendor); customer DPA (30-day sub-processor notice; use limits); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (reasonable measures); CCPA ADMT rules and Colorado SB26-189 assessed as not applicable today (P10 section 2)
status: In production since 2026-04-20; approved with conditions 2026-09-15; auto-accept for dates and limits off from 2026-10-15

use_case: Company-licensed generative AI coding assistant used by the CTO, the engineers, and the contract developer
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI coding assistant (SaaS; business terms with no training on inputs)
data_categories: Source code and Internal documents; customer data, secrets, and keys not allowed
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review and test all generated code through the normal pull request review
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01) only indirectly (code quality); customer DPA (no customer data may be entered)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft emails, sales material, or questionnaire answers
data_categories: Risk of customer data or Internal information being pasted
